subject: website
name: IPNS Inspector
summary: The IPFS project's IPNS Inspector, which shows and creates signed IPNS records in the browser, open source in ipfs/ipns-inspector (no licence file detected). It makes no request when it opens and runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: looking up a name asks the delegated routing server delegated-ipfs.dev, so the tool relies on a server, though the record is signed.

connections.name: Delegated routing (delegated-ipfs.dev)
connections.note: Asked only when a name is looked up or a record is published.
